assumptions.assumption: The urbanization degree of areas selected is derived from the Global Human Settlement Layer (JRC) (2023 edition) and is assumed constant across all SSP scenarios.
Urbanization rates are based on the UN World Urbanization Prospects 2025 revision and projections for the years 2030, 2050, 2100 are considered consistent across SSP scenarios.
Population under 5 (years of age) values are based on the UN World Urbanization Prospects 2025 revision and projections for the years 2030, 2050, 2100 are considered consistent across SSP scenarios.
It is assumed that national HDI values can be used for sub-national level analyses.
Country-specific projections were obtained by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) based on historical HDI trends and other socio-economic indicators.
